metadata.title: Phase 2C.5B4 Camera-Channel Implementation Contract Formal Errata and Provenance Amendment
metadata.reason: Correction of pre-implementation over-classification and boundary over-claims. Segregates authentic original binary protocol parity from phase scope guards, architectural implementation choices, and browser frontend reference representations.
effective_contract_rules: Base contract CAMERA_CHANNEL_B4_IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.json remains strictly frozen and immutable to preserve pre-implementation historical provenance.
Deferred channel isolation (CAM-B4-13) is classified as PHASE_SCOPE_GUARD and does not increase original protocol parity counters.
Corrects source relationship of CAM-B4-13 from FILE-B3-16 to FILE-B3-14.
Separates positive cross-component camera boundary facts (CAM-B4-12) from negative architectural exclusion guards.
Removes browser-specific 'ArrayBuffer' terminology from static Agent parity claims (CAM-B4-07), confining it to REFERENCE_ONLY frontend evidence.
Effective contract view is dynamically computed by combining the frozen base contract with this formal errata document.

corrections.original_claim: Inbound Binary JPEG Frame Ingestion and Snapshot Cache Ordering: Agent receives binary JPEG ArrayBuffer frames on camera-channel and caches the latest frame in latestCameraJpeg under mutex protection BEFORE attempting non-blocking channel enqueue (STATIC_CONFIRMED, mandatory_for_parity: true)
corrections.problem: 'ArrayBuffer' is a browser JavaScript DOM/WebAPI representation, not an authentic original Go Agent binary concept. Original Agent binary proves byte-level ingestion of raw binary JPEG data.
corrections.corrected_original_parity_claim: Agent receives binary JPEG payload bytes on camera-channel and caches the latest frame in latestCameraJpeg under mutex protection BEFORE attempting non-blocking channel enqueue.
corrections.non_original_compatibility_behavior: Browser client encodes canvas frames to image/jpeg and transmits them as ArrayBuffer objects over DataChannel (REFERENCE_ONLY).
corrections.rationale: Original Go Agent evidence verifies reception and processing of raw JPEG byte slices (msg.Data). The JavaScript ArrayBuffer type belongs strictly to Lane D reference frontend context.

corrections.original_claim: Physical-Camera vs Virtual-Camera Boundary Assertion: Virtual camera data plane routes exclusively through camera-channel and Camera HAL/bridge TCP socket (default 127.0.0.1:9001), strictly decoupled from scrcpy helper video UDS (@uds_sys_v_) and CameraCapture.java (CROSS_COMPONENT_CONFIRMED, mandatory_for_parity: true)
corrections.problem: Asserting that virtual camera injection routes 'exclusively' and is 'strictly decoupled from every possible path' elevates the absence of recovered call/data-flows into an over-strong negative static assertion. The confirmed cross-component fact is the positive binding of CameraCapture.java to physical capture and camera-channel to virtual injection.
corrections.corrected_original_parity_claim: CameraCapture.java is positively bound to the physical-camera capture pipeline. Recovered virtual-camera injection path is camera-channel -> Agent JPEG decode -> planar I420 -> camera TCP bridge.
corrections.non_original_compatibility_behavior: Virtual camera reconstruction must not route through CameraCapture.java or @uds_sys_v_ (IMPLEMENTATION_ARCHITECTURE_GUARD / PHASE_SCOPE_GUARD).
corrections.rationale: The positive data paths for physical camera capture and virtual camera injection are CROSS_COMPONENT_CONFIRMED. The negative routing exclusion is an architectural guard for reconstruction.

corrections.original_claim: Strict Isolation of Deferred Channels (AI and ADB): Channels 'ai-command-channel' and 'adb-channel' remain strictly deferred with inert lifecycle references only and zero payload processing logic (STATIC_CONFIRMED, mandatory_for_parity: true)
corrections.problem: Deferred channel isolation is an engineering scope guard to prevent premature out-of-scope reconstruction during Phase 2C.5B4, not an original Agent protocol parity requirement. Additionally, the base contract incorrectly referenced FILE-B3-16 instead of FILE-B3-14.
corrections.corrected_original_parity_claim: N/A (Engineering Phase Scope Guard: Channels 'ai-command-channel' and 'adb-channel' remain strictly deferred with inert lifecycle references only and zero payload processing logic).
corrections.non_original_compatibility_behavior: Deferred channels remain inert across Phase 2C.5B4 (PHASE_SCOPE_GUARD).
corrections.rationale: Inertness of deferred channels is a phase scope boundary rule. It must not be counted as an original static protocol parity requirement.
